keyframe_review.note: New keyframe for the whole life. The Weibo page names Wei Prefecture (capital) and Bei Prefecture and gives no full prefecture list or area; the 80 km circle is the one the later-liang dossier uses for Tianxiong in 915. Neither Weibo page nor the Luo Shaowei page draws a frontier.

ledger.note: 763: Tian Chengsi takes Weibo. 'Tian Chengsi took control of Weibo in 763 and rebelled against the court twice' (Weibo page); the An Lushan page: Weibo 'stayed independent' after the rebellion.
888: Luo Hongxin takes Weibo. The Weibo soldiers mutinied against Le Yanzhen, killed the officer Zhao Wenbian and backed Luo Hongxin, Luo Shaowei's father.

898: Luo Shaowei succeeds. After Luo Hongxin died the soldiers supported his son; Emperor Zhaozong made him full military governor and Prince of Changsha. In 899 Zhu Quanzhong's general Li Si'an drove back Liu Rengong's attack.
904: Weibo is renamed Tianxiong. 'Weibo Circuit was renamed Tianxiong Circuit, and Luo's title was raised from Prince of Changsha to Prince of Ye, after Zhu forced the court to move to Luoyang.'

ledger.note: 910: Luo Shaowei dies, and the Later Liang absorbs the circuit. Luo died on 4 July 910 after offering in 909 to give up direct control; his son Luo Zhouhan was acting, then full, governor (to 912), and the An Lushan page says Weibo was 'absorbed by the Later Liang in 910'.

notes: New state (Cliopatria lacks it); one of the Hebei Three Circuits of the Tang group's scope. The Weibo page's own end is unclear: it lists Luo Zhouhan 910-912 and Yang Shihou 912-915, the An Lushan page says Later Liang absorbed it in 910, and the later-liang dossier has the Tianxiong circuit lost to Jin in 915 after it was split; the dossier ends in 910, when Luo Shaowei died. Gaps: Tian Chengsi's successors (Tian Yue, Tian Xu, Tian Ji'an, Tian Hongzheng), the 821-822 troubles (Shi Xiancheng), the 827 rising of Li Tongjie and the prefecture list are not dated on the pages. The war's second rebel, the Chengde circuit (Li Weiyue), is carried by the zhao-five-dynasties-period dossier.
